summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K reporting amendments to previously issued Bridge Warrants, interim PIPE common warrants, and September Notes/Warrants, plus repayment of the Bridge Notes in full on September 25, 2026 from the closing of a registered direct offering. The amendments chiefly remove provisions permitting downward adjustment to warrant floor prices and revise anti-dilution terms. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, going-private or activist event is present; this is ordinary financing and capital-structure housekeeping for a Nasdaq-listed medical device issuer. Watch dilution mechanics, warrant overhang and any further floor-price resets.
